_doc: Where each CANary-HAT revision wires what software drives. One table, two readers:
hat_rev.py beside this file (bring-up scripts, install_pi.sh, program_hat.sh) and
overlay against its row. product_ver is what the board's ID EEPROM carries
A board with no readable CANary-HAT EEPROM is treated as 'unidentified': rev 2.0 is
the only revision that has run without one, and rev 2.1 needs its EEPROM to load its
own overlay at all. Rev 2.1's pin moves: docs/CANary-HAT-Rev2.1.md section 13.5.13.
adc_spi_device and sensor_power_gpio are the ADS8688A's (rev 2.1 only): its spidev
node and SENS_PWR_EN, the 5 V sensor supply's enable (section 13.5.12).
